specs.Item Type Name: Charger Case Cover With Black Pouch

features: 🛡️ Complete Charger Protection - Protect your Apple 18W/20W charger, charging cable, and connector from scratches, dust, daily wear, and accidental damage with this all-in-one protective set.
🎀 Cute Cartoon Design - Features an adorable kawaii cartoon character that gives your charger a fun and stylish look while making it easy to identify your charging accessories.
💎 Premium Silicone Material - Made from soft, flexible, high-quality silicone that provides a secure fit, shock absorption, and long-lasting durability without affecting charging performance.
🎒 Portable Hard Storage Case - Includes a premium EVA zippered storage case to keep your charger, cable, and accessories organized, protected, and easy to carry while traveling or commuting.
🎁 Perfect Gift Choice - A cute and practical charging accessory set for students, kids, girls, boys, and Apple users. Ideal for birthdays, holidays, or everyday use.
